verdict: MSI fatal error (1603) during app install. This is a wrapper exit code; the real cause is in the MSI verbose log.
fix: Re-run with MSI verbose logging on the client: `msiexec /i <msi> /l*v c:\windows\temp\install.log` and grep the log for `Return value 3` (the step that failed). Typical root causes: product already installed, SYSTEM lacks write on a target path, locked file from a prior install, TMP/TEMP pointing at an encrypted or read-only folder, or a missing MSI prerequisite.
